name: broken
svg_template:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="300" height="300" fill="none">
  <rect width="100" height="100" fill="${color-bg}"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="30" fill="url(#halo)"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="45" r="6">
    <animate attributeName="fill" values="${color-eye};white;${color-eye}" dur="${pulse-a}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>
  <use href="#pupil"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="45" r="6" fill="${color-iris}"/>
</svg>
